title: Cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, create a single loop and draw a circle with its center at coordinates (0.0469, 0.0469) and a radius of 0.0469 units. After drawing the circle, apply a scale factor of 0.0937 to the entire sketch. Ensure that the sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by rotating it using Euler angles of zero degrees in all axes and translating it using a vector of zero. To transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction. Do not extrude in the opposite direction. This extrusion operation will create a new solid body. The resulting cylindrical object has a flat top and bottom, with the top surface being slightly wider than the bottom. The cylinder has a length of 0.09375 units, a width of 0.09375 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base circle
circle_center = (0.0469, 0.0469)
circle_radius = 0.0469

# Create the circle in the sketch
workplane = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.75
extrude_scale = 0.0937

# Perform the extrusion operation
r = workplane.extrude(extrude_depth, taper=extrude_scale)

# Display the final model

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0469, 0.0469)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0469)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
